title: All About Ned
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, zz, qu, ch added, 32-sound stage.

pages.brief: Close view of Ned the gold duckling with his beak open, mid-quack, beside a log pile.
Ned the duckling quacking again, head tipped back, beside the log pile.
Side view of Ned the duckling, showing his wide flat bill clearly.
Ned the duckling with his bill down in dark mud near the log pile, hunting for bugs.
Ned the duckling curled up asleep on top of a log.
Ned the duckling standing beside a small brown beetle on the log, beak open as if talking.
Ned the duckling sitting contentedly in a patch of warm sunshine by the pond.
Ned the duckling standing tall and happy on the log, beak wide open, quacking.
